items.Sentence: Influent enters the headworks of the Facility and is processed through macerators (i.e., channel grinders) and into a wet well.
Wastewater is then conveyed to the secondary treatment system, which consists of two 370,000-gallon aeration basins
Wastewater is then conveyed to the secondary treatment system, which consists of...four rectangular clarifiers
...chlorination in two chlorine contact chambers with sodium hypochlorite...
...and dechlorination in an effluent channel with sodium bisulfite, prior to discharge through the ocean outfall at Discharge Point 001.
The system operates by sending disinfected secondary effluent water to an ultrafiltration membrane followed by a reverse osmosis membrane

A side stream rotary micro screening process removes rags and foreign materials from the tank prior to WAS being pumped to the DAFT.

Thickened sludge is then pumped to an aerobic digester, and the remaining wastewater is combined with DAFT process water
Sludge from the aerobic digesters is dewatered using a belt press, and biosolids are stockpiled in holding bins prior to disposal by composting facility.
